sentence_stem: Had she known about the delay,
correct_completion: she would have taken an earlier train.
full_sentence: Had she known about the delay, she would have taken an earlier train.
acceptable_variants: she would have chosen an earlier train.
she might have caught an earlier train.

options.text: she takes an earlier train every day.
options.why_wrong: This describes a present habit. The third conditional needs a past result, such as 'would have taken'.

options.text: she will take an earlier train tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' describes a future plan. An unreal past condition needs 'would have' to express the result.

options.text: she would have taken an earlier train.
she had taken an earlier train already.
options.why_wrong: 'Had taken' describes a completed action, not the imagined result of an unreal past condition.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with inverted 'Had' in the if-clause
explanation: The stem uses an inverted third conditional. The if-clause is about an unreal past situation, so the main clause must use 'would have' with a past participle.
